messages:
Ivy: Thinking of a split-screen indie night next Wed, 7pm in the lounge — mix of couch co-op, short speedrun sprints, and a 1-minute meme montage contest between rounds.
Deon: Count me in. I can bring my OLED TV and an extra controller.
Rhi: Im bringing a Switch with local co-op titles and a short speedrun demo Ive been practicing.
Carlos: Ill bring a capture phone mount so we can film the meme montages. Low-fi edits encouraged.
Ivy: Format idea: two 15-min speedrun heats, best times advance to a final; between heats, 60s meme montage (phone clips + dumb captions). Winner gets bragging rights + a tiny sticker.
Deon: Love the sticker prize. Also can someone bring HDMI splitter and a short HDMI cable? My TV is a bit far.
Rhi: I have a 3m HDMI and a tiny USB mic for voiceover during montages.
Carlos: Food: grab-and-go burritos and fruit? Any allergies?
Ivy: No nuts please (branch allergic). Also let's keep wine optionalwe're an early crew.
Deon: RSVP reactions: :video_game: playing, :tv: bringing TV, :camera: filming, :taco: food.
Rhi: :video_game: :tv:
Carlos: :camera: :taco:
Ivy: Quick tech note: if we do timed runs, I use LiveSplit but a phone stopwatch works fine. Example LiveSplit autosplit command I use for practice: 
```
Livesplit.Autosplitter.Start
```
Deon: Can we reserve the lounge from 6:45pm to 10pm so we can set up?
OfficeBot: Reservation confirmed: HQ Lounge 2026-04-15 18:45-22:00. Please follow community space rules and tidy after.
Ivy: Nice. Final plan: show up ~6:50 if youre helping set up. Bring labeled controllers and any chargers. Ill make a short montage template for people to drop clips into. See yall next Wed! :party_parrot:
